SELECT followPending.sign_trace_status, followPending.pending_status, signInfo.stock_code, signInfo.stock_name, signInfo.sign_type, signInfo.position, signInfo.price1, signInfo.display_release_time, DATE_ADD(signInfo.display_release_time, INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) AS display_release_time15, followTrading.buying_price, followTrading.buying_shares, followTrading.finish_time, followTrading.flow_time1, followTrading.flow_time2, followTrading.flow_time3, followTrading.flow_time4, followTrading.trading_position, followTrading.be_current_follow_sum, followTrading.af_current_follow_sum, followTrading.be_current_position_value_ratio, followTrading.af_current_position_value_ratio, followTrading.be_current_follow_position_value_ratio, followTrading.af_current_follow_position_value_ratio, followPending.pending_status, followRecord.follow_end_time, followRecord.follow_status FROM user_follow_up_pending followPending LEFT JOIN sign_info signInfo ON followPending.sign_id = signInfo.id LEFT JOIN user_follow_up_trading followTrading ON followPending.id = followTrading.pending_id LEFT JOIN user_follow_up_record followRecord ON followPending.follow_record_id = followRecord.id
followPending.user_id = #{param.userId} and
followPending.follow_record_id = #{param.followRecordId} and
followPending.position_id = #{param.positionId} and
signInfo.display_release_time >= CURDATE() and signInfo.display_release_time <= NOW() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE and
signInfo.display_release_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) and signInfo.display_release_time < CURDATE() and
signInfo.display_release_time >= #{param.displayReleaseTimeStart15} and
signInfo.display_release_time <= #{param.displayReleaseTimeEnd15} and
order by signInfo.display_release_time desc

SELECT followPending.*, tutorInfo.tutor_name AS tutorName, userInfo.level_id AS levelId, followRecord.follow_end_time, followRecord.follow_status, signInfo.item_type, signInfo.sign_type, signInfo.stock_code, signInfo.stock_name, signInfo.position, signInfo.price1, signInfo.price2, signInfo.display_release_time, signInfo.is_configured, followTrading.trading_order_sn, followTrading.finish_time, followRecord.current_follow_sum, levelDef.level_val, levelDef.level_name, ( SELECT buyFollowPosition.hold_shares FROM user_follow_up_pending buyFollowPending LEFT JOIN user_follow_up_position buyFollowPosition ON buyFollowPosition.id = buyFollowPending.position_id WHERE buyFollowPending.sign_id = signInfo.buy_sign_id AND buyFollowPending.user_id = followPending.user_id) AS realTimeHoldShares FROM user_follow_up_pending followPending LEFT JOIN tutor_info tutorInfo ON followPending.tutor_id = tutorInfo.id LEFT JOIN user_info userInfo ON followPending.user_id = userInfo.id LEFT JOIN user_follow_up_record followRecord ON followPending.follow_record_id = followRecord.id LEFT JOIN sign_info signInfo ON followPending.sign_id = signInfo.id LEFT JOIN user_follow_up_trading followTrading ON followPending.id = followTrading.pending_id LEFT JOIN level_def levelDef ON userInfo.level_id = levelDef.id
followPending.id = #{param.id} and
followPending.user_id = #{param.userId} and
userInfo.level_id = #{param.levelId} and
followPending.tutor_id = #{param.tutorId} and
followPending.follow_record_id = #{param.followRecordId} and
followPending.position_id = #{param.positionId} and
followPending.sign_id = #{param.signId} and
followTrading.trading_order_sn = #{param.tradingOrderSn} and
tutorInfo.domain_type = #{param.domainType} and
signInfo.item_type = #{param.itemType} and
signInfo.sign_type = #{param.signType} and
followPending.pending_time >= #{param.pendingTimeStart} and
followPending.pending_time <= #{param.pendingTimeEnd} and
followPending.pending_status = #{param.pendingStatus} and
followPending.sign_trace_status = #{param.signTraceStatus} and
( followRecord.follow_status = 0 AND ( followRecord.follow_end_time IS NULL OR
DATE(followRecord.follow_end_time) >= CURDATE() ) ) and
( followRecord.follow_status = 1 OR ( followRecord.follow_status = 0 AND
DATE(followRecord.follow_end_time) < CURDATE() ) ) and
followRecord.follow_status = 2 and
order by followPending.pending_time desc
